repairs.changes: POST /holds now requires seat_id, customer_id, and idempotency_key in the JSON body. ttl_seconds defaults to 120 and is constrained to 1..900. The persisted fingerprint covers every effective create field.

Cancellation is DELETE /holds/{hold_id} with an empty 204 response and idempotent replay. The SQLite partial unique index and pre-insert query cover both active and confirmed rows, so confirmation permanently consumes the seat.
A restart test constructs a second FastAPI app/store over the same SQLite file and proves both hold retrieval and idempotent create replay survive restart; changed-payload replay still returns 409.

HTTP_API.md and HANDOFF.md now document the locked request body, TTL bounds/default, DELETE 204 cancellation, persistence, and permanent confirmed-seat consumption. An OpenAPI regression test asserts those request and cancellation schemas.
